column_description: INTEGER. Foreign key to the races table (RAK_ID). FK to races. Example: 1093.
INTEGER. Foreign key to the drivers table (DRV_MAIN). FK to drivers. Example: 4.
INTEGER. Lap value in the race. Example: 55.
INTEGER. Position for the lap. Example: 7.
VARCHAR. Recorded lap-time string. **NULL means the lap time was not captured or is invalid.**. Example: 1:43.848.
INTEGER. Lap time in milliseconds. Example: 103848.
